decision: The exact free official present-vintage source passed identity, monthly-lattice and Validation support checks, but Design contained only eleven non-positive year-over-year months versus the frozen minimum of twelve. Because the missing state support is known before BTC access and no partial pass is allowed, close without economic testing.
prohibited_reopen: Do not lower the Design minimum-state gate from twelve to eleven after observing factor values.
Do not scan month-over-month change, another lookback, a magnitude threshold, regional permits, starts, completions or inverse direction.
Do not combine PERMIT with another factor to rescue the family.
Do not open BTC outcomes, create a hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate or OOS for this closed family.
learning: A one-observation gate miss still matters when it was frozen in advance. Relaxing twelve to eleven after seeing the data would turn a source-feasibility screen into post-hoc selection.
scope_note: No BTC outcome, hypothesis, manifest, economic runner, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
